title: Kissed Crunchy Mexican Corn Tlayudas
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Mexican dish featuring crunchy corn flour tlayudas with a mustardy flavor, perfect for a sick day
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine corn flour, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, and ground cumin
Add vegetable shortening to the bowl and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the corn flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs
Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable and smooth
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick
Heat a non stick skillet or griddle over medium high heat and cook the tlayudas for 30 seconds on each side, until lightly browned and crispy
In a small bowl mix together yellow mustard and 1 tablespoon of water
Brush the mustard mixture onto the cooked tlayudas
Sprinkle shredded monterey jack cheese over the tlayudas and return to the skillet for an additional 30 seconds, until cheese is melted and bubbly
Remove from heat and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro if desired
